`flatten` is implemented in `tasks/flatten/flat.py` (iterative, expands only lists, strings stay whole), and `python -m pytest -q tasks/flatten` passes (1 passed).
My extra deep-nesting probe crashed in Python's own parser (`eval` of 5000 brackets), so it never reached `flatten`, and I did not re-run it or the other edge cases.

`LRUCache` is implemented in `tasks/lru_cache/lru.py` using an `OrderedDict`. `python -m pytest -q tasks/lru_cache` passes (1 passed).
I also ran eviction by hand: `get` refreshes recency, `put` on an existing key refreshes it too, the least recently used key is evicted, and capacity 0 stores nothing.
